<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>

      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#E4A53F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E4A53F"/>

    <filter id="shadowSoft" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">

    <clipPath id="screenClip"><rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" rx="0"/></clipPath>
  </defs>

  <rect width="390" height="844" fill="#031A31"/>

    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#031A31"/>

    <!-- Status bar -->

        <rect x="20" y="6" width="16" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- Header -->

    <g filter="url(#shadowCard)">
      <rect x="14" y="144" width="362" height="248" rx="14" fill="#17162F" stroke="#053361" stroke-width="1"/>

    <g>

      <text x="82" y="786" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#8C8C8C">Talent partner · 9h ago</text>

      <text x="324" y="786" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">View</text>

      <!-- Home -->

        <polygon points="10,8 20,0 30,8" fill="none" stroke="#8C8C8C" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
